findings.title: Immediate cancellation bypasses the deferred-cancellation limit fix
findings.body: This branch sends the SendGrid cancellation request immediately and returns without setting `cancelled` or deleting the reminder. It is used for rescheduling and workflow/step deletion, so cancellations for reminders scheduled far in the future accumulate in SendGrid's pending-cancellation list until their scheduled dates. That recreates the 100-pending-cancellations limit this change is intended to avoid; once the limit is reached, later cancellations can fail and the reminder emails can still be sent. The retained reminder rows also remain unmarked and are not picked up by the cancellation cron.

findings.title: The scheduler can schedule reminders already marked cancelled
findings.body: This query selects unscheduled email reminders without excluding `cancelled: true`. A cancelled reminder whose scheduled date is more than an hour away is therefore submitted to SendGrid and marked scheduled, despite the cancellation marker. The cancellation cron may eventually cancel it near its scheduled date, but until then the supposedly cancelled email has been re-enqueued and can still be delivered if that later cancellation fails or does not run.
